title: Dataset of Philippine Presidents' Speeches from 1935 to 2016
reasoning: The paper conducts a sentiment and topic analysis of political speeches. While the content of the speeches may touch upon moral or ethical themes in a political context, the paper's methodology is focused on text mining techniques (LDA, sentiment analysis) to identify topics and sentiment, not on evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the research.
